Messages.Author: Braddock
Messages.Body:
If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
(or Wynn...) is minion B tapped or not (providing he wasn't tapped before
combat, of course) ?

If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
(or Wynn...) can minion B block this action (in order to prevent optional
maneuver from Bum's Rush, or to spend unwanted intercept cards) ?

Braddock.

Messages.Author: Ramsteiner
Messages.Body:
In article <8i7aun$qrf$1...@as102.tel.hr>,
"Braddock" <ek-...@elektrokem.tel.hr> wrote:
> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven
Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) is minion B tapped or not (providing he wasn't tapped
before
> combat, of course) ?
>

Minion B would not be tapped as it is the object of someone else's
action and has done nothing to make it tap.

> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven
Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) can minion B block this action (in order to prevent
optional
> maneuver from Bum's Rush, or to spend unwanted intercept cards) ?
>

Yes, Minion B can block the "rush" action. (Please note that we at
Ramstein define rush as the action of one minion attacking another
methuselah's minion to initate combat. This is not to be confused with
Bum's Rush, the card)
If Minion B is blocking the Bum's Rush action, the use of intercept is
not possible unless the attacker uses stealth modifiers after your
announced block attempt. The blocked Bum's Rush would stop the
attacker from gaining the maneuver and Minion B would then be tapped
after combat.
If Minion B is blocking a Haven Uncovered or Wynn "rush", the use of
intercept cards is required and again, would be tapped after combat.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Braddock wrote:
>
> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) is minion B tapped or not (providing he wasn't tapped before
> combat, of course) ?

Since there is nothing that says to tap minion B, he is not tapped.

> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) can minion B block this action (in order to prevent optional
> maneuver from Bum's Rush, or to spend unwanted intercept cards) ?

Yes. B can attempt to block any action directed at B's controller. See
section 6.2.2.1 of the rules.

Messages.Author: Sorrow
Messages.Body:
> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) is minion B tapped or not (providing he wasn't tapped before
> combat, of course) ?

No. Unless card text explicitely states the a vampire should tap (ie,
Deflection),
the only reason a minion ever taps is to act or to block. Since, in the
above
situation, minion B did not block, minion B is not tapped.

> If minion A enters combat with minion B via Bum's Rush or Haven Uncovered
> (or Wynn...) can minion B block this action (in order to prevent optional
> maneuver from Bum's Rush, or

Yes. You can block any action that is directed at your or one of the
minions
you control, an undirected action taken by your predator/prey or any action
on the table if you use superior Eagle's Sight or have Anneke. The rules of
stealth and intercept apply in all the above cases.
Now, since the action is directed at minion B, minion B can block
successfuly
so long as minion B has greater than or equal intercept than minion A has
stealth.

> to spend unwanted intercept cards) ?

You can only gain intercept if you need it. That is, you cannot play any
intercept cards unless the action you are attempting to block has more
stealth than you have intercept. Since Bum's Rush is a 0 stealth action
and minion B has 0 intercept, minion B does not need the intercept and
as such cannot play it.

Sorrow
